localChanges: When a save can't be read or written, the message now quotes the problem as it is, without codes in place of its quotation marks (#472).
The message saying a city is too large for Settlers to join now writes names such as Xi'an correctly (#472).
The Civil Disorder button's tooltip now names the city, rather than showing a placeholder (#472).
The Trade report now names each city improvement, such as "City Walls" rather than "CityWalls" (#472).
The window asking whether to reload the page is now titled "Reload" rather than "Quit", and the last few fixed English labels can now be translated (closes #472).
